build_model_from_openai_state_dict: build a CLIP model from an OpenAI pretrained state dictionary with auto-detected vision and text config
trace_model: trace a CLIP model with example image and text inputs for TorchScript export
convert_weights_to_fp16: convert all applicable CLIP model parameters to fp16 precision for memory efficiency
resize_pos_embed: resize the visual positional embedding grid in a state dict to match a new image size
CLIP_encode_image: encode a batch of images into normalized feature vectors using the CLIP visual tower
